resources.string: Please grant the \'Do Not Disturb\' permission
The \'Do Not Disturb\' permission is required to set the phone to silent mode. Please allow the app to use this permission.
Select \'Quick Settings Sound Profile\' in the app list and grant the permission.
You\'re all set and ready to go!
Place the sound tile in your quick settings panel and toggle between the different sound profiles.
If enabled, media will be muted when the device gets muted. Media level will be restored to its original volume when the device is unmuted.
